subject: Vendor activation: invoice submission options & minimal template
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <ap@clearpathlogistics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor activation — invoice submission options

Hi Jonas,

We're prepping ClearPath Logistics to go live as a Redwood vendor and I want to confirm the invoice intake process so our AP team can standardize files. A few quick questions:

- Do you prefer invoices submitted through a vendor portal only, or is email a supported fallback?
- If email fallback is OK, what exact subject/header fields do you need (PO in subject, invoice number, vendor ID, etc.)?
- What minimal line-item fields do you require (unit price, qty, SKU, GL code)? Would a CSV with one line per line-item be acceptable or do you require a PDF?
- Any mandatory filename or metadata conventions (PO#.pdf, vendor-123_invoice.pdf)?
- SLA for ACKs on submitted invoices?

We can conform to either flow but want to build the attachment/export from our ERP to match your requirements.

Thanks — I can send a sample file by EOD if that helps.

Alyssa Park
AP Manager
ClearPath Logistics

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <ap@clearpathlogistics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor activation — invoice submission options

Hi Alyssa — glad to have ClearPath moving through onboarding. Short answers up front, then specifics you can share with your AP team.

Summary (preferred -> fallback):
1) Preferred: Redwood Vendor Portal (secure, immediate ACKs, automatic PO-match).
2) Fallback: Email to ap@redwood.com with a strict subject/header pattern and the minimal template we attach.

If you go with email fallback, please follow these rules so our ingestion pipeline handles your files reliably:
- Subject: Redwood INV | PO#<PONUMBER> | CP-447
- Required header fields on the first page or separate CSV columns: vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, vendor_id (we'll provide), invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), invoice_total, currency, PO_number (if applicable).
- Minimal line-item columns (CSV preferred for bulk uploads): description, sku_or_service_code, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, GL_account (optional). PDFs are accepted but slow to process (OCR fallback).
- Filenames: preferred format vendorid-invoiceNumber.pdf or vendorid_invoiceNumber.csv. Example: CP447_INV_000123.pdf
- Multi-PO invoices: accepted if each line includes the PO_number column. For mixed-PO single PDF, include a cover CSV with line mapping.
- ACK SLA: automated ACK within 48 hours for portal uploads; email-uploads get an automated receipt within 48 hours and a manual QA window of up to 5 business days for PO matching exceptions.

I'm attaching: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf and a minimal invoice template (redwood_invoice_template_minimal_v1.xlsx). The template is intentionally compact — our AP system needs only those columns for automated consumption.

Action items:
- Alyssa: send one sample CSV/PDF by end of day so we can validate mapping.
- Vanessa/Monica: once sample arrives, we'll run a quick ingestion test and flag any field mismatches.

On governance: if ClearPath requires us to accept invoices via an alternate email or SFTP, we can onboard that channel but it will require a short ops ticket (security review).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if your ERP team wants to walk through export options.

Jonas Weber
Supplier Onboarding
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf, redwood_invoice_template_minimal_v1.xlsx)

Quick ops notes — tagging for finance:
- Confirm whether VAT/tax breakdown is required in its own column for EU vendors (we should enforce for EU vendors).
- For Dedicated accounts we need a billing tag in the invoice (tenant_id or account_label) to route costs correctly. Can we require a "billing_account" column in the template for those?
- Also: if a vendor sends PDF only, OCR can lose SKU/service code. Recommend we require CSV for first 30 days of live transactions to validate mappings.

If you agree, I'll add a short paragraph to the onboarding form requiring CSV for first 30 days and the billing_account field when applicable.

Vanessa
Billing Ops
Redwood Inference
